summary: Israeli forces destroyed ten weapon manufacturing tools in the Ka'batya area of the Menashe Brigade during overnight operations, while Hamas confirmed the killing of two militants in central Gaza. Iran continues Hormuz corridor negotiations with Oman amid US obstruction claims, and indirect Israel-Lebanon border talks mediated by the US continue in Rome until August 6. Regional tensions persist with ongoing maritime incidents in the Red Sea and Gulf areas.
key_points: Israeli forces destroyed ten weapon manufacturing tools in Ka'batya area of Menashe Brigade during overnight operations (Source: @idf_telegram/24824)
Hamas confirmed killing of two militants in central Gaza city of Muhammad Salam Ahmed Drouish and Samir Zakaria Abu Dallah (Source: @lelotsenzura/94060)
Iran-Oman Hormuz corridor negotiations continue despite US obstruction, with Iran demanding transit fees and guarantees (Source: @presstv/201609)
Israel-Lebanon border talks mediated by US continue in Rome until August 6, according to Israeli Foreign Ministry (Source: @yediotnews25/133586)
Iranian Revolutionary Guard ships targeted violating vessels near Hormuz, with smoke columns observed (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382873)
Indian cargo ship hit and sunk near Yemeni port of Hudaydah in Red Sea (Source: @presstv/201614)

points: Iranian Foreign Ministry reported a strong explosion heard in Shahreza area of Tehran province, with smoke rising from an aluminum plant facility, though no official confirmation of circumstances (Source: @yediotnews25/133573)
Iran is considering allowing European states to collect transit fees in the Strait of Hormuz through a voluntary fund model similar to the Strait of Malacca framework (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6063)

Iranian officials stated that negotiations with Oman on Hormuz corridor arrangements have entered a new phase despite US obstruction, with Iran demanding rights to collect transit fees and guarantees against renewed attacks (Source: @presstv/201609)

A senior Iranian official told Reuters that the proposed Hormuz plan with Oman would grant Iran total authority over all inbound maritime traffic, with Oman clearing outbound vessels only after Iranian notification (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6053)

Iranian sources claim US and regional partners attempted to make the southern route permanent but faced firm Iranian resistance, with US military actions failing to change Iranian decisions (Source: @SharghDaily/176237)
Iran's Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf is scheduled to visit Pakistan on August 10 for bilateral discussions (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382875)

Israeli Defense Forces destroyed ten weapon manufacturing tools used for producing explosives and weapons in the Ka'batya area of the Menashe Brigade during overnight operations (Source: @idf_telegram/24824)
IDF forces operating with Battalion 890 and Yamam unit conducted operations in the Ka'batya space of Menashe Brigade, destroying ten weapon manufacturing tools (Source: @idf_telegram/24822)
Israeli Foreign Ministry confirmed that talks between Israel and Lebanon, opened today in Rome under US mediation, will continue until August 6 (Source: @yediotnews25/133586)

Israeli forces issued demolition and sealing orders for the home of terrorist Farooq Ramadan in Kafr Tulkarm, who carried out a shooting attack on July 24, 2026, resulting in the deaths of Lt. Col. (res.) Binyamin Meltz and Capt. Yoav Ezra (Source: @idf_telegram/24822)
Israeli Foreign Ministry spokesperson stated that progress has been made in talks regarding the Hormuz corridor, hoping the matter will be resolved very soon (Source: @New_security8200/203197)
Israeli Foreign Minister mentioned that four Ugandan nationals and one Pakistani national are being investigated in connection with a case being examined by UK authorities (Source: @N12chat/220655)
Hamas confirmed the killing of two militants in central Gaza: Muhammad Salam Ahmed Drouish (Abu Wadi) and Samir Zakaria Abu Dallah (Abu Jabal) in an attack (Source: @lelotsenzura/94060)
Israeli forces blocked a Palestinian ambulance carrying a critical patient to a hospital in the occupied West Bank (Source: @presstv/201613)
According to new instructions, every elimination in the Gaza Strip now requires approval from the Chief of Staff (Source: @lelotsenzura/94063)

Four remaining soldiers involved in the Givatai rebellion were sentenced, with three receiving 30 days imprisonment, expulsion from combat service, and immediate removal from warfare duties (Source: @inon_yttach/9805)
A 17-year-old youth lost consciousness in a pool in Tzfat, received medical treatment from paramedics, and was transported to Ziv Hospital in serious condition (Source: @N12chat/220656)
A prominent 50-year-old lawyer was shot dead in a street shooting on Moshe Halel Street in Rishon Lezion (Source: @pkpoi/143507)
Red Alert Lebanon reported a signal disruption in the Western Bekaa Valley and extreme caution areas (Source: @redlinkleb/34707)
Artillery shelling was reported in the Aytaron area, with ongoing monitoring of the situation (Source: @redlinkleb/34703)
Artillery shelling was also reported in the Ali Al-Tahir area, with continued tracking of developments (Source: @redlinkleb/34741)

The Israeli Northern Command emphasized that there is no change in the situation assessment or civilian guidelines despite reports of increased readiness along the Syrian border (Source: @New_security8200/203200)
Indirect talks between Israel and Lebanon, opened today in Rome under US mediation, are scheduled to continue until August 6 (Source: @yediotnews25/133586)
Syria has agreed to drastically reduce its Russian oil imports as Washington considers removing Damascus from the last major terrorism sanctions (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6050)

Iraqi television network Asharqiyoun broadcast video showing clashes between supporters of the Islamic Republic and followers of Ayatollah Sadegh Shirazi during Arbaeen ceremonies in Karbala, resulting in 140 arrests and 54 injuries (Source: @VahidOnline/77735)

The clashes began when groups carrying images of Ali and Mojtaba Khamenei and flags of 'Ya Lazarat al-Hussein' and 'Ya Lazarat al-Khamenei' gathered outside Ayatollah Sadegq Shirazi's office in Karbala, leading to confrontations with his supporters (Source: @VahidOnline/77735)

Iraqi police initially intervened to stop the clashes, but tensions continued between Islamic Republic supporters and Iraqi security forces, with police eventually using force to restore order (Source: @VahidOnline/77735)

Ayatollah Sadegh Shirazi, a critic of the Islamic Republic's velayat al-faqih theory, considers it limited to judicial authority and opposes new interpretations of Shia Islam (Source: @VahidOnline/77735)

Pakistan's Commerce Minister Jam Kamal Khan announced that Tehran and Islamabad have agreed on a roadmap to increase bilateral trade to 10 billion dollars by removing trade barriers and advancing toward a free trade agreement (Source: @presstv/201616)

Qatar's Emir held a phone call with US President Trump, discussing efforts to reduce tensions between Washington and Tehran, emphasizing the importance of dialogue and adherence to the understanding memorandum (Source: @SharghDaily/176238)

Qatar's Emir emphasized the importance of dialogue, utilizing diplomatic solutions, and all parties' commitment to the understanding memorandum during discussions with President Trump (Source: @SharghDaily/176237)
Iranian Foreign Minister stated that Iran-Oman talks on Hormuz corridor arrangements show Iran's diplomatic engagement and determination to safeguard its rights (Source: @presstv/201609)
Stock markets reached record highs amid hopes for a Hormuz corridor deal that puts pressure on oil prices (Source: @naya_foriraq/86936)

sections.threat_assessment: Regional tensions remain high with active military operations in Gaza and ongoing border tensions with Lebanon. Iran's Hormuz corridor negotiations with Oman face US obstruction, potentially escalating maritime conflicts in the Gulf. Depleted US missile defense stocks limit American response options, increasing risk of miscalculation. Maritime incidents in the Red Sea and Gulf areas continue to pose threats to commercial shipping. Internal Iranian political tensions, as evidenced by clashes in Karbala, may affect regional stability.
sections.regional_response: The US continues mediating Israel-Lebanon border talks while simultaneously obstructing Iran-Oman Hormuz negotiations. Qatar's Emir engages in diplomatic efforts with President Trump to reduce US-Iran tensions. Pakistan explores economic cooperation with Iran through trade agreements despite regional pressures. European states consider participating in Iran's proposed voluntary fund for Hormuz navigation services. Regional actors balance diplomatic engagement with military preparedness amid ongoing conflicts.
sections.intelligence_notes: Israeli operational tempo remains high with targeted eliminations requiring Chief of Staff approval, indicating elevated security protocols. US military resource depletion during recent Iran conflict suggests limited capacity for sustained regional operations. Iranian domestic political divisions, particularly regarding velayat al-faqih, may influence foreign policy decisions. Maritime domain awareness in the Gulf and Red Sea requires enhanced monitoring due to multiple overlapping incidents. Intelligence sharing between regional actors appears fragmented, with conflicting reports on key developments.
